scientific_integrity: The generator, stationary covariance, integrated variance and global optimization are derived analytically; a separately executable finite numerical test corroborates selected parameters. Earlier stationary and first-passage results are credited. Literature priority remains subject to external verification.
scientific_limitations: Theorem for stationary one-dimensional driftless Brownian motion with an independent constant-rate Poisson jump process, fixed signed multiplier strictly between -1 and 1, and signed finite-window position averages. Optimality is not asserted for first passage, nonstationary starts, refractory intervals, energy dissipation, or arbitrary reset marks. Monte Carlo does not prove the all-parameter theorem.
title: A monotone finite-window optimal reversal for proportional Brownian resetting
